in_hebrew.name: Francklyn
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו French variation of Franklin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Francklyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old French name 'Franclein', meaning 'Frenchman' or 'free man'. The name Franklin, from which Francklyn is derived, means 'freeman' in Old English.

in_latin.name: Francklyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Franciscus significat 'homo liber', et nomen liber significat 'liber, nomen Christianum'. Nomen lynx significat 'sagittarius, fidelis'. In hac nominibus Franciscus, liber, lynx, et Christianus sunt omnia nomina Christiana, quae sunt in usu Christianorum ab antiquis temporibus.
